real_acceptance.manual_source: Authorized test-account user confirmed the real homepage, Reload, complete close/reopen, invite records, copy link targeting the test Bot, and Logout all worked. Native Telegram accessibility could not safely perform these clicks; no synthetic initData was used for this acceptance.
real_acceptance.recovery_boundary: An expired earlier session and a fresh launch initData produced recover 401 followed by successful exchange 200. Reload recovered the existing session with 200. Logout is scoped to the current session, not every session for the user; the final snapshot contains one logout revocation and one earlier active session subject to its existing expiry. This is not evidence that all sessions were revoked.

evidence_boundary: Real test-Bot acceptance combines user-operated Telegram results, observed safe request logs, and a strict-TLS read-only database snapshot. No live Points, Growth, inventory or redemption operation was exercised. Unchanged counts and account reconciliation do not prove every historical row is identical. Browser automated tests use isolated synthetic contracts; real old-Bot login was not repeated in this final round. Original HMAC mismatch cause is not fully established; official Telegram Ed25519 signature verification passed for the server-configured Bot ID.
